paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Ultra 4, the ultimate sports and adventure watch, now includes new, advanced health and fitness features, and longer battery life. CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple Watch Ultra 4 — the ultimate sports and adventure watch — now including new, advanced health and fitness features, and longer battery life. Engineered with the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip, Apple Watch Ultra 4 delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, 1 higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, and a new readiness score to support athletes of all kinds. Apple Watch Ultra 4 also offers extended battery life to track outdoor workouts for up to 45 hours and the most accurate on-device GPS in a sports watch. 2 A redesigned Health app on iPhone arrives later this year, including a new Longevity tab with a Health Age feature showing how metrics are tracking relative to a user’s age. In addition to powering the Health Sensing System, the S11 chip — Apple’s most powerful wearable chip — enables new Audio Intelligence features arriving later this year, to help users remember key moments from their conversations and stay alert to important sounds, built with privacy, security, and accessibility innovations at the core. 3 With watchOS 27, Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI on Apple Watch, bringing personal context understanding and broad world knowledge to the wrist. These features add to the many ways Apple Watch Ultra already supports users with advanced workout tracking across activities, sleep tracking, powerful health features like heart health notifications and the ECG app, 4 and game-changing safety capabilities like satellite communications. 5 Apple Watch Ultra 4 is the most comprehensive wearable across health, fitness, and safety. 6 A black-and-white photo of a runner wearing Apple Watch Ultra 4 sprints outdoors. paragraphs.en: “With powerful health and fitness insights including readiness, new intelligent features, and its large, bright display, Apple Watch Ultra 4 is designed to support you wherever you go, from your workouts, to adventures, to everything you tackle in a day.” The Most Accurate Heart Rate Sensing in a Wearable Apple Watch Ultra 4 is re-architected to provide continuous high-fidelity health monitoring using the Health Sensing System, featuring new optical and electrical heart sensors. Using this system and the S11 chip, Apple Watch Ultra 4 offers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable. A scientifically rigorous study on a diverse population of over 1,000 participants compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, with Apple Watch showing the highest accuracy across devices. With larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, Apple Watch Ultra 4 now measures heart rate every five seconds, all day long. This continuous passive measurement delivers deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state while making Exercise and Move Activity rings even more accurate. Users can view their real-time heart rate at a glance throughout their day on a new heart rate watch face complication. Apple Watch Ultra 4 is re-architected to provide continuous high-fidelity health monitoring using the Health Sensing System, featuring new optical and electrical heart sensors. HRV, a key indicator of stress and recovery, is now measured up to 24 times more often and available to view in a new section of the Heart Rate app. Apple Watch provides two separate variants of HRV for better understanding of a user’s health status. Recovery HRV is best for identifying daily signals of stress and recovery, while overall HRV is best for insights into a user’s broader health, including cardiovascular health. Higher variability is generally associated with better overall recovery, while a lower variability value is an indicator of stress. Using the higher-frequency heart rate and HRV measurements offered by Apple Watch Ultra 4, a new daytime vitals view lets users toggle between overnight and daytime metrics, and can potentially spot shifts in their metrics before they show up overnight. Overnight vitals now includes recovery HRV measurements analyzed against a user’s personal baseline, providing a more complete view of their health status.
paragraphs.zh: “凭借强大的健康与健身洞察功能（包括身体准备度）、全新的智能特性以及大尺寸高亮度显示屏，Apple Watch Ultra 4 专为随时随地支持您而设计——无论是日常锻炼、探险活动，还是应对一天的各种挑战。”Apple Watch Ultra 4 实现了穿戴设备中最精准的心率感应功能。其全新架构的健康传感系统持续提供高保真健康监测，并配备了全新的光学与电学心率传感器。 借助该系统和 S11 芯片，Apple Watch Ultra 4 可提供穿戴设备中最精准的心率感应功能。 一项针对超过 1,000 名多样化参与者的严谨科学研究，将 Apple Watch 的新心率感应准确性与主流可穿戴设备进行了对比，结果显示 Apple Watch 在所有设备中准确率最高。 Apple Watch Ultra 4 的光学心率传感器采用了更大且能效更高的绿色 LED，现在可全天候每五秒测量一次心率。 这种持续被动测量功能能更深入地洞察用户的健身状态和生理状况，同时使“锻炼”和“活动”环的准确性进一步提升。 用户全天都能通过全新的心率表盘小部件，一目了然地查看实时心率。 Apple Watch Ultra 4 采用了全新架构，借助健康传感系统持续提供高保真健康监测，并配备了全新的光学与电学心率传感器。 心率变异性（HRV）是衡量压力与恢复状态的关键指标，如今其测量频率提升了最多 24 倍，并可在“心率”应用的新版块中查看。 Apple Watch 提供了两种独立的 HRV 变体，帮助用户更清晰地了解自身健康状况。 恢复期 HRV 最适合识别日常的压力与恢复信号，而整体 HRV 则更适合深入了解用户的全面健康状态，包括心血管健康。 较高的变异性通常意味着更好的整体恢复能力，而较低的变异性值则是压力的标志。 借助 Apple Watch Ultra 4 提供的高频心率与 HRV 测量数据，全新的日间体征视图让用户可以在夜间与日间指标之间切换，并可能提前发现指标的变化，而这些变化在夜间尚未显现时即可被捕捉到。 夜间体征功能现在包含恢复期 HRV 的测量结果，并与用户的个人基准数据进行对比分析，从而提供更全面的健康状况视图。

sents.zh: 一项针对超过 1,000 名多样化参与者的严谨科学研究，将 Apple Watch 的新心率感应准确性与主流可穿戴设备进行了对比，结果显示 Apple Watch 在所有设备中准确率最高。

sents.en: With larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, Apple Watch Ultra 4 now measures heart rate every five seconds, all day long.
sents.zh: Apple Watch Ultra 4 的光学心率传感器采用了更大且能效更高的绿色 LED，现在可全天候每五秒测量一次心率。

sents.en: This continuous passive measurement delivers deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state while making Exercise and Move Activity rings even more accurate.
sents.zh: 这种持续被动测量功能能更深入地洞察用户的健身状态和生理状况，同时使“锻炼”和“活动”环的准确性进一步提升。

sents.en: Users can view their real-time heart rate at a glance throughout their day on a new heart rate watch face complication.
sents.zh: 用户全天都能通过全新的心率表盘小部件，一目了然地查看实时心率。

sents.en: Apple Watch Ultra 4 is re-architected to provide continuous high-fidelity health monitoring using the Health Sensing System, featuring new optical and electrical heart sensors.
sents.zh: Apple Watch Ultra 4 采用了全新架构，借助健康传感系统持续提供高保真健康监测，并配备了全新的光学与电学心率传感器。

sents.en: HRV, a key indicator of stress and recovery, is now measured up to 24 times more often and available to view in a new section of the Heart Rate app.
sents.zh: 心率变异性（HRV）是衡量压力与恢复状态的关键指标，如今其测量频率提升了最多 24 倍，并可在“心率”应用的新版块中查看。

sents.en: Apple Watch provides two separate variants of HRV for better understanding of a user’s health status.
sents.zh: Apple Watch 提供了两种独立的 HRV 变体，帮助用户更清晰地了解自身健康状况。

sents.en: Recovery HRV is best for identifying daily signals of stress and recovery, while overall HRV is best for insights into a user’s broader health, including cardiovascular health.
sents.zh: 恢复期 HRV 最适合识别日常的压力与恢复信号，而整体 HRV 则更适合深入了解用户的全面健康状态，包括心血管健康。

sents.en: Higher variability is generally associated with better overall recovery, while a lower variability value is an indicator of stress.
sents.zh: 较高的变异性通常意味着更好的整体恢复能力，而较低的变异性值则是压力的标志。

sents.en: Using the higher-frequency heart rate and HRV measurements offered by Apple Watch Ultra 4, a new daytime vitals view lets users toggle between overnight and daytime metrics, and can potentially spot shifts in their metrics before they show up overnight.

sents.en: Overnight vitals now includes recovery HRV measurements analyzed against a user’s personal baseline, providing a more complete view of their health status.

paragraphs.en: previous next Privacy by Design Audio Intelligence features are private by design, combining hardware, software, and services to protect user privacy in a way that only Apple can. These features do not create or store audio recordings, and raw audio used for processing is completely inaccessible to the operating systems, apps, the user, or Apple. This is because the S11 chip on Apple Watch Ultra 4 includes Secure Exclave, a dedicated hardware-isolated compartment that processes audio in complete isolation from the rest of the system, then immediately deletes it. Users are in control and can choose whether to opt in to each Audio Intelligence feature. They can decide exactly where and when Siri Recap takes notes, and can turn Siri Recap on or off at any time, right from Control Center. By design, Audio Intelligence features do not identify and attribute speakers, to protect the privacy of both the user and those around them. Siri Recap produces a brief, high-level summary of conversations — not a transcript — and is designed to exclude sensitive information like financial information or government-assigned identifiers. Live Rewind plays an audible chime when it is being used, even if Apple Watch is on silent, and shows a full-display animation and microphone indicator so people nearby can hear and see that the feature has been activated. Live Rewind text snippets and Siri Recap summaries are end-to-end encrypted in the Siri app with iCloud syncing, and are not accessible even by Apple. Read more about how Audio Intelligence protects privacy. Siri Recap and Live Rewind arrive in beta later this year. Apple Watch Ultra 4 and the Environment The new Apple Watch Ultra 4 was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 45 percent recycled material overall, 17 including 100 percent recycled titanium in the 3D-printed titanium case and 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery. All of the electricity used to manufacture Apple Watch Ultra 4 is sourced from renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain, and Apple has also invested in enough renewable energy around the world to match the electricity customers use to charge their Apple Watch. Like all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 18 and can be easily recycled at home. paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple Watch Ultra 4 — the ultimate sports and adventure watch — now including new, advanced health and fitness features, and longer battery life.
paragraphs.zh: 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日推出了 Apple Watch Ultra 4，这是一款终极运动与探险手表，现已加入全新、先进的健康与健身功能，并具备更长的电池续航时间。

paragraphs.en: Engineered with the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip, Apple Watch Ultra 4 delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, 1 higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, and a new readiness score to support athletes of all kinds. Apple Watch Ultra 4 also offers extended battery life to track outdoor workouts for up to 45 hours and the most accurate on-device GPS in a sports watch. 2 A redesigned Health app on iPhone arrives later this year, including a new Longevity tab with a Health Age feature showing how metrics are tracking relative to a user’s age. In addition to powering the Health Sensing System, the S11 chip — Apple’s most powerful wearable chip — enables new Audio Intelligence features arriving later this year, to help users remember key moments from their conversations and stay alert to important sounds, built with privacy, security, and accessibility innovations at the core. 3 With watchOS 27, Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI on Apple Watch, bringing personal context understanding and broad world knowledge to the wrist.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Ultra 4 采用全新的健康传感系统和 S11 芯片打造，实现了可穿戴设备中最精准的心率检测，支持更高频率的心率和心率变异性（HRV）测量，并引入新的准备度评分，为各类运动员提供支持。 Apple Watch Ultra 4 还延长了电池续航时间，可连续追踪长达 45 小时的户外锻炼，并拥有运动手表中最精准的内置 GPS。2 今年晚些时候，iPhone 上的健康 App 也将迎来重新设计，新增“长寿”选项卡，其中包含“健康年龄”功能，用于展示各项指标相对于用户年龄的变化趋势。 S11 芯片不仅是健康传感系统的动力核心，也是苹果迄今性能最强的可穿戴芯片，它还支持今年晚些时候推出的全新音频智能功能，帮助用户记住对话中的关键瞬间，并敏锐捕捉重要声音；这些功能以隐私、安全和无障碍创新为核心进行设计。3 借助 watchOS 27，Apple Intelligence 将为 Apple Watch 上的 Siri AI 提供动力，将个人情境理解与广泛的世界知识带到用户腕间。

Using this system and the S11 chip, Apple Watch Ultra 4 offers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable. A scientifically rigorous study on a diverse population of over 1,000 participants compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, with Apple Watch showing the highest accuracy across devices.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Ultra 4 经过重新架构，借助健康传感系统可提供持续的高保真健康监测，并配备了全新的光学和电学心率传感器。 通过该系统和 S11 芯片，Apple Watch Ultra 4 实现了可穿戴设备中最精准的心率检测。 一项针对超过 1,000 名多样化参与者的严谨科学研究，将 Apple Watch 的新心率检测精度与主流可穿戴设备进行了比较，结果显示 Apple Watch 在所有设备中准确率最高。

sents.zh: 通过该系统和 S11 芯片，Apple Watch Ultra 4 实现了可穿戴设备中最精准的心率检测。

sents.en: A scientifically rigorous study on a diverse population of over 1,000 participants compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, with Apple Watch showing the highest accuracy across devices.
sents.zh: 一项针对超过 1,000 名多样化参与者的严谨科学研究，将 Apple Watch 的新心率检测精度与主流可穿戴设备进行了比较，结果显示 Apple Watch 在所有设备中准确率最高。

paragraphs.en: With larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, Apple Watch Ultra 4 now measures heart rate every five seconds, all day long. This continuous passive measurement delivers deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state while making Exercise and Move Activity rings even more accurate. Users can view their real-time heart rate at a glance throughout their day on a new heart rate watch face complication.
paragraphs.zh: 光学心率传感器采用了更大且能效更高的绿色 LED，因此 Apple Watch Ultra 4 现在能够全天每五秒测量一次心率。 这种持续被动测量方式能更深入地了解用户的健身状况和生理状态，同时让锻炼与活动环的准确性进一步提升。 用户可以在全新的心率表盘小工具上随时查看实时心率。

paragraphs.en: HRV, a key indicator of stress and recovery, is now measured up to 24 times more often and available to view in a new section of the Heart Rate app. Apple Watch provides two separate variants of HRV for better understanding of a user’s health status. Higher variability is generally associated with better overall recovery, while a lower variability value is an indicator of stress.
paragraphs.zh: HRV 是衡量压力与恢复状态的关键指标，如今其测量频率最高可达原来的 24 倍，并且可在“心率”应用的新版块中查看。 Apple Watch 提供两种独立的 HRV 版本，以便用户更清晰地了解自身健康状况。 恢复期 HRV 最适合识别日常的压力与恢复信号，而整体 HRV 则更适合深入了解用户的全面健康状态，包括心血管健康。 较高的变异性通常意味着更好的整体恢复状态，而较低的变异性值则是压力的标志。

paragraphs.en: Readiness: A Daily Read on the Body’s Capacity
paragraphs.zh: 准备状态：关于身体能力的每日阅读

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Ultra 4 introduces readiness, a new feature that analyzes a user’s recent activity, training load, vitals, and sleep score to offer insight into their capacity for the day ahead. Readiness provides a single 0-10 score each day with a clear, actionable recommendation: Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready, or Go For It. This helps a user decide how to take on their day, whether they’re headed into a workday or tackling their training plan.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Ultra 4 推出了“准备度”这一新功能，该功能会分析用户近期的活动、训练负荷、身体指标和睡眠评分，从而提供关于其应对当天挑战能力的洞察。 “准备度”每天都会给出一个从 0 到 10 的单一评分，并附带清晰且可操作的建议：恢复、控制节奏、准备就绪或全力以赴。 这有助于用户决定如何安排自己的一天，无论他们即将开始工作日还是执行训练计划。

The scoring algorithm was developed using data from the Apple Heart and Movement Study, in collaboration with exercise scientists and physicians at Apple.
paragraphs.zh: 全天根据新数据的到来持续更新准备状态，以反映例如高强度锻炼或日间生命体征的变化。 准备状态清晰地突出了哪些因素在影响该评分，并允许用户进一步查看更多详细信息。 该评分算法是在与 Apple 的运动科学家和医生合作的基础上，利用 Apple 心脏与运动研究的数据开发而成的。

paragraphs.en: A Redesigned Health App Offering a Holistic View of Long‑Term Health
paragraphs.zh: 重新设计的健康应用：提供全面长期的健康视角

paragraphs.en: The Health app on iPhone serves as a central and secure location for a user’s health and fitness information, uniquely positioning it to provide a better understanding of a user’s health. The Health app has been redesigned to dynamically respond to a user’s data using Apple Intelligence, with a new Insights tab that surfaces timely health information and a new Longevity tab that analyzes a user’s longitudinal health data for deeper insights. The Longevity tab includes Health Age, an Apple Watch feature that shows users how certain metrics are tracking relative to their actual age. 12
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 上的“健康”App 是一个集中且安全的位置，用于存储用户的健康和健身信息，这使其能够更清晰地帮助用户了解自身健康状况。 “健康”App 经过重新设计，可借助 Apple Intelligence 动态响应用户数据，并新增了一个“洞察”选项卡，用于呈现及时的健康信息，以及一个“长寿”选项卡，用于分析用户的长期健康数据以获取更深入的了解。 “长寿”选项卡包含“健康年龄”功能，这是 Apple Watch 的一项功能，可让用户了解某些指标相对于其实际年龄的变化趋势。12

paragraphs.en: Audio Intelligence: A New Way to Stay More Present and Engaged Throughout the Day
paragraphs.zh: 音频智能：全天保持专注与投入的新方式

paragraphs.en: Since Apple Watch is always on a user’s wrist, it is the perfect device to help users stay alert to important sounds and stay present and engaged in conversations throughout the day. With the built-in microphone, the power of the S11 chip, the latest Apple Intelligence models on iPhone, and Private Cloud Compute, Apple Watch Ultra 4 offers a brand-new class of Apple Intelligence features. Audio Intelligence helps users stay aware of the world around them, catch what they missed, and remember key moments — with user control, privacy, security, and accessibility at the center of its design.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 Apple Watch 始终佩戴在用户的腕间，因此它是帮助用户随时留意重要声音、全天保持专注并积极参与对话的理想设备。 凭借内置麦克风、S11 芯片的强大性能、iPhone 上的最新 Apple Intelligence 模型以及私有云计算功能，Apple Watch Ultra 4 带来了全新类别的 Apple Intelligence 功能。 音频智能功能可帮助用户感知周围的世界、捕捉错过的内容并记住关键时刻——其设计始终以用户控制、隐私、安全和无障碍为核心。

sents.en: Audio Intelligence helps users stay aware of the world around them, catch what they missed, and remember key moments — with user control, privacy, security, and accessibility at the center of its design.

paragraphs.en: Audio Intelligence features are private by design, combining hardware, software, and services to protect user privacy in a way that only Apple can. These features do not create or store audio recordings, and raw audio used for processing is completely inaccessible to the operating systems, apps, the user, or Apple. This is because the S11 chip on Apple Watch Ultra 4 includes Secure Exclave, a dedicated hardware-isolated compartment that processes audio in complete isolation from the rest of the system, then immediately deletes it.
paragraphs.zh: 音频智能功能在设计上具有隐私性，通过结合硬件、软件和服务，以唯有 Apple 才能实现的方式保护用户隐私。 这些功能不会创建或存储音频录音，且用于处理的原始音频对操作系统、应用程序、用户或 Apple 均完全不可访问。 这是因为 Apple Watch Ultra 4 上的 S11 芯片包含安全飞地（Secure Exclave），这是一个专用的硬件隔离区域，可在与系统其余部分完全隔离的状态下处理音频，随后立即将其删除。

paragraphs.en: Users are in control and can choose whether to opt in to each Audio Intelligence feature. They can decide exactly where and when Siri Recap takes notes, and can turn Siri Recap on or off at any time, right from Control Center.

paragraphs.en: The new Apple Watch Ultra 4 was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 45 percent recycled material overall, 17 including 100 percent recycled titanium in the 3D-printed titanium case and 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery. All of the electricity used to manufacture Apple Watch Ultra 4 is sourced from renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain, and Apple has also invested in enough renewable energy around the world to match the electricity customers use to charge their Apple Watch. Like all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 18 and can be easily recycled at home.
paragraphs.zh: 新款 Apple Watch Ultra 4 在研发过程中充分考虑了环境因素，推动了苹果实现“到 2030 年使其整个业务足迹完全碳中和”这一宏伟计划的进程。 该产品整体采用 45% 的回收材料制成，其中包括 3D 打印钛外壳中 100% 回收的钛以及电池中 100% 回收的钴。 Apple Watch Ultra 4 制造过程中使用的全部电力均来自供应链中的可再生能源（如风能和太阳能），此外，苹果还投资了全球范围内足以匹配用户为 Apple Watch 充电所需电量的可再生能源。 与所有苹果产品一样，其纸质包装完全由纤维制成，并可在家庭环境中轻松回收。
